title: Timed buffered composition
statement: Let $F,G$ be finite Turing machines over the binary alphabet, let $x,y,z$ be binary words, and let $s,t\in\mathbb{N}$. If $F$ computes $y$ from $x$ within $s$ steps and $G$ computes $z$ from $y$ within $t$ steps, then their buffered sequential composition computes $z$ from $x$ within $s+|y|+2+t$ steps.
replaced:
If a machine $F$ computes $y$ from $x$ within $s$ steps and a machine $G$
computes $z$ from $y$ within $t$ steps, then the buffered composition of $F$ and
$G$ computes $z$ from $x$ within $s + |y| + 2 + t$ steps.
